children: Mundra steps down after disclosing her son’s IndianOil retail outlet dealership, citing the independence criteria under SEBI regulations

Dr Alka Mundra has resigned as Independent Director of Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL), effective 18 September 2026, citing a pecuniary relationship arising from her son’s operation of an IndianOil retail outlet dealership in Rajasthan.

In her resignation letter, Mundra said her son, Madhav Mundra, has been operating the Swarn Ganga KSK IndianOil Retail Outlet dealership in Udaipur, Rajasthan, since 2020. She said the relationship creates a pecuniary connection that does not meet the independence criteria under Regulation 16(1)(b)(v)(D) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations.

Mundra clarified that her son operates the dealership independently and that the arrangement would not affect her objectivity. However, she decided to step down to uphold corporate governance standards and avoid any questions regarding her independence.
Mundra confirmed that there were no other material reasons for her resignation.
She was not a member of any board committees of the company and does not hold directorships in any other listed entities.
The disclosure has been made by Indian Oil under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
